card.name: The first name Ronald
card.fires_on: The first name Ronald (or its pieces Ron, ald) when a person's name is being written, especially before a middle initial or surname such as Reagan, McNair or Fisher.

modes.label: Whole name Ronald
modes.description: The full first name Ronald appears before a middle initial or surname.

modes.label: Inside the name
modes.description: The pole fires on the pieces Ron or ald when the name is split, or on the period after the initial.

card.plain: It lights up when a person named Ronald is being written, just before the last name.
